subject: NFL Week 2: Steelers–Patriots leads 10 games worth researching
preview_text: Widest gap to a book number: 5.4 points on Indianapolis Colts at Kansas City Chiefs. 10 of 10 featured games carry a book number. Research, not picks.

paragraphs: EdgeDesk scored 16 upcoming NFL games for Week 2 and put 10 in front of you.
